newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris, RJR.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Philip Morris, RJR.

text.p: -- Sanford C. Bernstein & Co analyst Gary Black said he reiterated outperform ratings on Philip Morris Cos Inc and RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp.

-- "With both sides now openly discussing the concept of a legislative settlement, with no major litigation news until April and further upside revision likely at both (Philip Morris and RJR Nabisco), we see another 20-25 percent in both Philip Morris and RJR shares by mid-year 1997," Black said in a research note.
-- Philip Morris shares were up 1/8 at 117 and RJR was down 3/8 at 33-5/8.
